umrah.makkahDesc: Makkah is the holiest city in Islam, home to the Masjid al-Haram and the sacred Kaaba. Every year, millions of Muslims journey here to perform Umrah and Hajj, fulfilling a profound spiritual calling. The city pulses with devotion, history, and an unmatched sense of unity among believers from every corner of the world.
umrah.makkahSub1Desc: The Kaaba, draped in its iconic black kiswah, stands at the heart of Masjid al-Haram — the largest mosque in the world. It is the qibla toward which all Muslims pray and the focal point of Tawaf during Umrah and Hajj.
umrah.makkahSub2Desc: Beyond the Haram, Makkah is rich with sacred history — from the Well of Zamzam to the hills of Safa and Marwa, and the Cave of Hira where revelation first descended. The city blends timeless spirituality with modern hospitality.
umrah.madinahDesc: Madinah, the radiant city, holds a special place in every Muslim's heart as the city that welcomed the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). Known for its tranquility and spiritual warmth, Madinah offers pilgrims a serene atmosphere for reflection, prayer, and connection with Islamic heritage.
umrah.madinahSub1Desc: The Prophet's Mosque is one of the holiest sites in Islam, featuring the iconic Green Dome beneath which the Prophet (peace be upon him) is laid to rest. A prayer here holds immense spiritual reward, drawing millions of visitors year-round.
umrah.madinahSub2Desc: Madinah is a haven of tranquility where pilgrims find inner peace. Visit Quba Mosque — the first mosque in Islam, stroll through the historic date palm gardens, and experience the gentle hospitality that has defined this blessed city for centuries.
umrah.faq1Q: What does a comprehensive Umrah package include?
umrah.faq1A: Our comprehensive packages include visa processing, return flights, hotel accommodation near Al-Haram, daily meals, ground transportation between cities, guided Umrah rituals, and Ziyarat tours to sacred sites.
umrah.faq2Q: How far in advance should I book my Umrah trip?
umrah.faq2A: We recommend booking at least 4-6 weeks in advance to ensure visa processing and preferred hotel availability, especially during peak seasons like Ramadan.
umrah.faq3Q: Can I customize my Umrah package?
umrah.faq3A: Yes! Our custom package option lets you choose your preferred hotel category, transport class, meal plans, and additional services. Contact us for a personalized quote.

destinations.title: Destinations in Egypt
destinations.subtitle: Unlock Secret Gems for Unforgettable Discoveries

destDesc.aswan: Aswan, the jewel of Upper Egypt, sits gracefully along the Nile. Known for its stunning sunsets, Nubian villages, and the magnificent Philae Temple, Aswan offers a serene escape from the bustle of modern life. Explore the Unfinished Obelisk, sail on a traditional felucca, and discover the engineering marvel of the High Dam.
destDesc.cairo: Cairo, the sprawling capital of Egypt, is a city of contrasts where ancient wonders meet modern energy. Home to the Great Pyramids of Giza, the Egyptian Museum, and the vibrant Khan el-Khalili bazaar, Cairo pulses with history at every corner. From the Citadel of Saladin to the bustling streets of Islamic Cairo, every visit reveals new layers of this incredible city.
destDesc.hurghada: Hurghada is Egypt's premier Red Sea resort, famous for its crystal-clear waters and vibrant coral reefs. Whether you're a seasoned diver or a first-time snorkeler, the underwater world here will leave you breathless. Beyond the beach, explore the Eastern Desert on a quad bike safari or experience traditional Bedouin hospitality under the stars.
destDesc.luxor: Often called the world's greatest open-air museum, Luxor is home to some of Egypt's most iconic monuments. The Valley of the Kings, Karnak Temple, and Luxor Temple stand as testaments to ancient Egyptian civilization. Cross the Nile to the West Bank to discover the Colossi of Memnon and the Mortuary Temple of Hatshepsut.
destDesc.sharmElSheikh: Sharm El Sheikh, nestled between the desert mountains and the Red Sea, is a world-class diving destination. Ras Mohammed National Park, Tiran Island, and the Blue Hole at Dahab offer some of the best diving in the world. The resort also serves as a gateway to Mount Sinai and St. Catherine's Monastery.
destDesc.marsaAlam: Marsa Alam is a paradise for nature lovers and diving enthusiasts seeking unspoiled coral reefs and marine life. Swim with dolphins at Samadai Reef, explore the pristine Elphinstone Reef, or relax on secluded beaches. This emerging destination offers a quieter alternative to Hurghada while delivering world-class underwater experiences.
destDesc.mersaMatruh: Mersa Matruh, on Egypt's Mediterranean coast, boasts some of the most beautiful beaches in North Africa. The turquoise waters of Cleopatra's Beach and Ageeba Beach rival any Caribbean destination. Rich in World War II history and blessed with a mild climate, Mersa Matruh is the perfect summer getaway.

excDesc.snorkeling: Dive into Egypt's underwater paradise! Our snorkeling tours take you to the most vibrant coral reefs in the Red Sea, where you'll encounter colorful fish, sea turtles, and stunning marine landscapes.
excDesc.luxury: Indulge in the finest Egypt has to offer with our luxury experiences. From private yacht cruises to exclusive temple visits and five-star desert glamping, every moment is crafted for discerning travelers.
excDesc.boatTrips: Sail the legendary Nile aboard our luxury cruise ships or explore the Red Sea coast on a private boat. Our cruises combine world-class comfort with breathtaking scenery and expert-guided shore excursions.
excDesc.safaris: Venture into the vast Egyptian deserts on thrilling safari adventures. Ride quad bikes across golden dunes, meet Bedouin families, stargaze under clear desert skies, and discover hidden oases.
excDesc.fastTrack: Skip the queues and enjoy seamless arrivals with our VIP airport services. Our team handles visa processing, customs, luggage, and transfers so you can start your Egyptian adventure stress-free.
excDesc.cultural: Walk in the footsteps of pharaohs with our expert-guided cultural tours. From the Pyramids of Giza to the temples of Luxor, experience 5,000 years of civilization with passionate local Egyptologists.
excDesc.adventure: For thrill-seekers and explorers, our adventure tours offer sandboarding, rock climbing, camel treks, and overnight desert camps. Discover the wild beauty of the White Desert, Siwa Oasis, and more.
excDesc.cityBreaks: Experience the vibrant pulse of Egypt's cities. Explore Cairo's bustling markets, Alexandria's Mediterranean charm, or Aswan's tranquil Nubian villages — each city tells a unique story.
excDesc.nightTours: Egypt comes alive after dark! Enjoy the Sound and Light shows at the Pyramids, Nile dinner cruises with live entertainment, traditional Tanoura dance performances, and Cairo's vibrant nightlife.
excDesc.transfers: Travel between airports and hotels in comfort with our reliable private transfer service. Modern vehicles, professional drivers, and door-to-door service across all Egyptian cities and resorts.

handbook.bestTimeContent: October to April offers the most comfortable weather for sightseeing. Summer (June–August) is ideal for Red Sea beach resorts. Ramadan dates vary — plan accordingly for a unique cultural experience.
handbook.visaContent: Most nationalities can obtain a visa on arrival or an e-visa before travel. Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months. Gedotravel's Fast Track service handles all arrival formalities for you.
handbook.currencyContent: The Egyptian Pound (EGP) is the local currency. Major credit cards are accepted in hotels and large shops. ATMs are widely available. We recommend carrying some cash for markets and smaller vendors.
handbook.cultureContent: Egypt is a warm and hospitable country. Dress modestly when visiting mosques and churches. Tipping (baksheesh) is customary. Learn a few Arabic phrases — locals appreciate the effort!
handbook.connectivityContent: Stay connected with a local SIM card or our eSIM service. Wi-Fi is available in most hotels. Consider our eSIM package for seamless connectivity throughout your trip.
handbook.healthContent: Egypt is generally safe for tourists. Drink bottled water, use sunscreen, and stay hydrated. Travel insurance is recommended. Gedotravel provides 24/7 support for all travelers.

testimonialsList.r1Text: Absolutely incredible experience! Our guide was knowledgeable and passionate. The Nile cruise exceeded all expectations. Gedotravel made everything seamless from airport pickup to departure.

testimonialsList.r3Text: The attention to detail was remarkable. Every hotel was excellent, transfers were always on time, and our Egyptologist guide brought the ancient temples to life. A trip of a lifetime!
testimonialsList.r4Text: We traveled as a family with young children and Gedotravel accommodated every need. The kids loved the snorkeling in Hurghada and the camel ride at the Pyramids. Perfect family vacation!
testimonialsList.r5Text: This was our third trip with Gedotravel and they never disappoint. The new luxury Nile cruise was outstanding — the food, service, and excursions were all five-star. Already planning trip number four!
testimonialsList.r6Text: As someone from the region, I had high expectations — and Gedotravel exceeded them. The MICE event they organized for our company was flawless. 200 guests, zero issues. True professionals.
